procedure.heading: If [GENE] ON:
procedure.text: 'GENE RST' circuit breaker ........ CHECK not popped out. [GENE RST] ................. PRESS. Unnecessary equipment ........ OFF. U bus on VEMD ................. MONITOR. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE.

procedure.heading: If [GENE] NOT ON:
procedure.text: Unnecessary equipment ........ OFF. U bus on VEMD ................. MONITOR. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE or CONTINUE FLIGHT as per operational judgment.

WARNING: IF THE BATTERY FAILS, THE VEMD WILL GO OUT AND NR/N2 INDICATION IS LOST. APPLY THE PROCEDURE FOR FAILURE OF BOTH SCREENS (SECTION 3.5 § 1 VEMD SCREEN FAILURE). AVOID AUTOROTATION, PERFORM A SHALLOW APPROACH WITH A CAUTIOUS LANDING.
NOTE: GENE comes on if the DC system is supplied with external power.

procedure.text: 1. Collective ....................................... REDUCE POWER. 2. [FUEL P] or [FUEL PUMP] .......... ON. LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. Low power approach and landing.
WARNING: BE PREPARED IN CASE OF AN ENGINE FLAME-OUT.

procedure.heading: Continuously on (pre-clogging level 2 reached):
procedure.text: WARNING: FUEL FILTER BY-PASS OPENING LEADS TO CONTAMINATION OF THE FUEL LINES AND THE GOVERNOR, WHICH MAY INDUCE N1 OSCILLATIONS, LIMITED POWER OR POSSIBLY FLAME-OUT. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE. VEMD ................... MONITOR N1. If N1 oscillations occur: LAND IMMEDIATELY.

procedure.heading: Flashing at idle or during starting or shutdown (pre-clogging level 1):
procedure.text: One flight of 3 hours maximum flight time can be performed before maintenance action.

procedure.heading: Continuously on:
procedure.text: Governing function degraded. 1. Collective ....................... AVOID abrupt power changes. 2. IAS .................................. MAINTAIN below VNE power off. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE. On ground: Do not start engine.

procedure.heading: Flashing at idle or during starting or shutdown:
procedure.text: Governor redundancy failure, no impact on governing function. Start-up procedure: Abort, refer to Maintenance Manual. Autorotation training: Cancel training, return to base.

name: GOV
description: Major governor failure. Emergency mode (EBCAU) engaged.

procedure.heading: In flight:
procedure.text: 1. Flight parameters ...................... CHECK, apply VEMD failure of both screens procedure, if required (see NOTE below). Emergency mode (EBCAU) automatically self-engages. GOV illuminates. 2. Collective ................................... AVOID abrupt changes. If N1 still available: Maintain N1 > 80% Hp below 20000 ft (6096 m). Maintain N1 > 85% Hp at or above 20000 ft (6096 m). LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE. 3. Approach and Landing: If N1 not available: - Lower collective to maintain NR in normal operating range. Make a powered approach. Avoid steep angle. 4. After touch down, shut-down: Collective .................................... SLOWLY down to low pitch. Engine starting selector ................ OFF.

procedure.heading: During engine starting:
procedure.text: Engine starting selector .................. OFF position immediately.
NOTE: This failure can also result in loss of Delta N1, N1, TRQ, TOT parameters and engine oil temperature and pressure indications on the VEMD. On VEHICLE page: FF and END.
